oracle_alignment.acceptance_binding: Each active obligation has exactly one bound Acceptance whose assertions, expected/forbidden outcomes, and observables align with that obligation.
oracle_alignment.red_intent_binding: Each Acceptance has its declared RED intent(s), and every supplied failure intent targets a declared Acceptance with expected_outcome=fail.

source_recall.reason: Source recall is a separate gate; this partition supplies source indexing but no recall-validation result.
